name: Streaming A Super Agent Based Framework For Reputation Management And Community Formation  Efdc2Cb74E
text: A Super-Agent-Based Framework for Reputation Management states that super-agents can form communities and build service reputation from the opinions of members with similar interests and judgment criteria. This extends Kaal's community-standing account of reputation governance with a concrete peer-group formation mechanism. The abstract does not state how that reputation allocates decision power or how objectively it can be measured.
